title: Explore Gujarat
shortDescription: Gujarat, located on the western coast of India, is a vibrant state known for its rich cultural heritage, spiritual significance, diverse landscapes, and historical landmarks.
description: Gujarat, located on the western coast of India, is a vibrant state known for its rich cultural heritage, spiritual significance, diverse landscapes, and historical landmarks. From sacred pilgrimage sites like Dwarka and Somnath to the majestic Statue of Unity, Gujarat offers a unique blend of tradition, history, and modern attractions. The state is famous for its colorful festivals, traditional handicrafts, delicious cuisine, and warm hospitality.

itinerary.title: Arrived Ahmedabad
itinerary.description: Today on Arrival Ahmedabad Airport or Railway Station, Proceed to visit Gandhi Ashram, Akshardham temple and Adalaj stepwell, Kankaria lake, RiverFront. Overnight stay at hotel.

itinerary.title: Ahmedabad – Jamnagar
itinerary.description: After breakfast, check out and drive to Jamnagar. Visit Lakhota Lake and the Lakhota Museum. In the evening, visit the Bala Hanuman Temple, known for its nonstop Ramdhun since 1956 and listed in the Guinness Book of World Records.

itinerary.title: Jamnagar – Dwarka
itinerary.description: Today after breakfast checkout from hotel. Proceed to sacred town of Dwarka, Visit Dwarkadeesh Temple and Gomti Ghat. In the afternoon take a trip to Bet Dwarka, visit Old Temple of Krishna. On the way to Bet Dwarka, visit Nageshwar Temple – One of the 12th Jyotilingam of Shiva. Rukmini Temple and Gopi Talav Evening Visit Shivrajpur beach enjoy water sport, Return back to Dwarka.

itinerary.title: Dwarka – Somnath
itinerary.description: Today after breakfast checkout from hotel. Proceed to Somnath Enroute Porbandar visit Kirti Mandir – A place where Gandhiji was born. Later proceed to Somnath, visit Bhalka Tirth & Somnath Temple. In the evening watch light and Sound show. Overnight stay at hotel.

itinerary.title: Somnath – Sasan Gir
itinerary.description: Today after breakfast checkout from hotel. Proceed to Sasan Gir. Sasan gir, is the home of the Asiatic Lion. In the afternoon Visit Gir Interpretation Zone at Devaliya. Gir Information center. Overnight stay at the hotel.

itinerary.title: Sasan Gir – Virpur – Gondal – Ahmedabad Drop
itinerary.description: Today after breakfast checkout from hotel. Proceed to Ahmedabad. Enroute visit Jalaram Temple at Virpur and Swaminarya temple, Navlakha Palace and Vintage Car museum at Gondal. Then proceed to Ahmedabad. Drop at Airport or Railway Station with lots of happy memories.

inclusions: AC Cab for all transfers and sightseeing exactly as per the itinerary
Toll, Parking, driver allowance, road tax & fuel charges
exclusions: Additional sightseeing or extra usage of vehicle, other than mentioned in the itinerary

seo.title: Explore Gujarat – 5N/6D
seo.description: Explore Gujarat: 5 nights in Ahmedabad, Jamnagar, Dwarka, Somnath, Sasan Gir. Includes Gandhi Ashram, Akshardham and Adalaj Stepwell.
